web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.summaryBand: Confirmed confidence and approved allocations {confirmed}; Expected confidence {expected}; Possible confidence {possible}; capacity line {capacity}
web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.displayBasis: Percentages show Confirmed plus Expected hours divided by effective capacity. Possible is separate. Partial figures describe visible plans only. Exports keep the weekly hours basis.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.linkedDeadlineBasis: Deadline markers cover visible projects linked to these people by plans, approved allocations or assigned work. The project filter limits this deadline set. Undated records stay separate.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.projectDeadlineBasis: Open milestone and deliverable dates for this project, separate from allocation filters and hours
web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.monthBasis: Each ISO week belongs to the month of its Thursday. Totals use only the displayed weeks. Month totals are read-only; choose a week to inspect its contributions.
web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.chooseWeek: Choose a week to inspect contributions
web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.roleHoursOnly: Unfilled role demand stays in hours
web/src/i18n/en.ts.planner.projectPercentBasis: Each row's visible hours as a percentage of that person's effective capacity for the displayed weeks; separate rows are not additive
